meta.title: Bounce — launch, 2 December 2026
meta.description: Launch keynote for Bounce, a social app with no likes and no strangers: the frustration, the reveal, three features one per slide, beta proof, a user voice, and free availability in 14 countries.

slides.heading: Today, social media stops keeping score.
slides.lead: No likes. No follower counts. Just your people.
slides.notes: Let the line sit for three seconds before you say anything else.

slides.heading: Teens spend 4.8 hours a day on apps that make them feel worse
Meet Bounce
slides.lead: A feed of 25 friends that ends when you are caught up.

slides.heading: Your feed holds 25 friends, and never a stranger

slides.body: Add up to 25 people. No public profile, no follow button, no suggested accounts.

slides.eyebrow: Feature 2 · The end of the feed
slides.heading: The feed stops when you are caught up
slides.lead: Beta users closed the app after 11 minutes a day, on average.
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 1600 400'><rect width='1600' height='400' fill='%23b6f542'/><g font-family='Nunito,Arial' font-weight='800'><rect x='120' y='70' width='300' height='70' rx='18' fill='%23ffffff' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='5'/><text x='150' y='117' fill='%230f0f1a' font-size='28'>Jade · 2 new</text><rect x='120' y='170' width='300' height='70' rx='18' fill='%23ffffff' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='5'/><text x='150' y='217' fill='%230f0f1a' font-size='28'>Omar · 1 new</text><rect x='120' y='270' width='300' height='70' rx='18' fill='%23ffffff' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='5'/><text x='150' y='317' fill='%230f0f1a' font-size='28'>Priya · 3 new</text><path d='M470 205 H900' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/><path d='M880 180 L910 205 L880 230' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/><rect x='960' y='80' width='520' height='250' rx='30' fill='%230f0f1a'/><text x='1010' y='195' fill='%23b6f542' font-size='58'>That's all.</text><text x='1010' y='260' fill='%23ffffff' font-size='30'>See you tomorrow · 11 min</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: Three friend updates lead to an end card that reads That's all, see you tomorrow.

slides.heading: Only you see who reacted to your post
slides.image: data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 450 750'><rect width='450' height='750' fill='%23fff3ea'/><rect x='45' y='150' width='360' height='450' rx='32' fill='%23ffffff' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='5'/><g font-family='Nunito,Arial' font-weight='800'><text x='75' y='210' fill='%230f0f1a' font-size='26'>Seen only by you</text><rect x='75' y='240' width='300' height='80' rx='16' fill='%23ff4d2e' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='95' y='290' fill='%23ffffff' font-size='24'>Jade sent a hug</text><rect x='75' y='345' width='300' height='80' rx='16' fill='%23b6f542' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='95' y='395' fill='%230f0f1a' font-size='24'>Omar: so you</text><rect x='75' y='450' width='300' height='80' rx='16' fill='%23ffffff' stroke='%230f0f1a' stroke-width='4'/><text x='95' y='500' fill='%235c5666' font-size='24'>no public count</text></g></svg>
slides.imageAlt: A private reactions panel: a hug from Jade, a comment from Omar, and no public count.
slides.body: Reactions go to the poster only. There is no number to chase and nothing to compare.

slides.heading: 83% of beta users felt better after a week on Bounce
slides.label: felt better
slides.lead: Versus 31% after a week on their old app. Bounce beta survey, September 2026, n = 9,200.
slides.notes: Read the comparison out loud. 83 against 31 is the whole launch in one number.

slides.quote: I deleted Instagram three times this year. I open Bounce because my friends are there, and then I close it.

slides.heading: Bounce is free today on iOS and Android in 14 countries
Keep your friends. Drop the score.
slides.lead: Download it tonight and invite your first five people.
slides.notes: Echo the cover: no score. The ask is one action tonight, five invites.
